subject.why: Clearly depicts a crystal ball on a small golden stand with a soft pink swirl and a tiny star inside, exactly matching the brief.

category.why: The object floats in the air with no floor or table, viewed from a slight three-quarter angle against a vibrant yellow gradient with radiating rays.

clean.why: Free of any text, numbers, UI, frames, watermarks, or characters.

framing.why: The crystal ball is well-centered with ample, balanced breathing room on all sides.

colour.why: Warm, bright, and saturated palette with strong contrast between the cool bluish/pink ball and the warm yellow background.

detail.why: Smooth, chunky shapes with no noisy micro-textures, scratches, or unnecessary props.

style.why: Features the same soft satin sheen, chunky volumes, and clean 3D casual game look as the references.
